title: Project an approximately uniform fixed-first-arc Euler tour to an approximately uniform rooted tree
statement: Fix a first labelled arc rooted at its tail. The BEST last-exit map sends each Euler tour to a rooted in-arborescence and has exactly product_v(deg(v)-1)! tours per tree, independent of the tree, retaining labelled parallel/loop arcs in the tour representation. Uniform tours therefore project to uniform rooted in-arborescences, and deterministic TV contractivity sends an epsilon-TV tour sample to an epsilon-TV tree sample. All tour generation costs remain paid: the constant-fibre projection supplies neither a nearlinear tour sampler nor a counting/normalizer oracle. BEST is established imported combinatorics, credited once.
